      Sustainability features

      This product has sustainability features recognized by trusted certifications.
      Energy efficiency
      Conserves energy compared to similar products.
      As certified by
      ECOLOGO

      ECOLOGO

      ECOLOGO certified products are made with materials that reduce environmental impact at one or more stages of their life cycle, from raw materials to end of life. An ECOLOGO certification indicates that a product has met environmental performance standards, which include criteria in some or all of the following categories: materials, energy, manufacturing and operations, health and environment, product performance and use, and product stewardship and innovation. Products are evaluated on the applicable criteria through testing and auditing.

      Learn more about this certification
      EPEAT

      EPEAT

      EPEAT certifies electronic products based on sustainability impacts across their life cycle including requirements for energy efficiency and end-of-life management. An EPEAT registered product can also meet optional more ambitious criteria including reduction of fluorinated greenhouse gases (F-GHGs). Products meeting 50% - 74% optional criteria are 'Silver' and those meeting 75% or more are 'Gold'.

      Learn more about this certification

      How trade-in works
      How trade-in works
      1. Upgrade and save
      Accept your estimated trade-in value, buy your new device at the current price, and receive your delivery.
      2. Prepare device
      Sign out of all accounts linked to your old device, and factory reset it to erase your personal information.
      3. Ship within 30 days
      Print your shipping label, package your old device, and drop it off at any UPS location within 30 days of receiving your new device.
      4. Get your rebate
      After we receive your trade-in device, we'll verify it within 10 business days. Once verified, you'll receive your trade-in value as an Amazon.com Gift Card to your Amazon account for immediate use.

      About this item

      • MULTIPLE TASKS WITH ONE ASK: Streamline your day with an assistant that gets you. Ask it to Google search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend— your Galaxy S25 Ultra handles multiple tasks with a single ask.¹
      • START THE DAY SMARTER: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it with Now Brief.²
      • REDUCE THE NOISE. REVEAL THE MAGIC: AI Camera with Audio Eraser lets you capture vibrant videos in low light and minimize unwanted noises so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.³
      • BRING OUT THE BEST IN EVERY FACE: Capture every portrait with clarity and confidence on the Galaxy S25 Ultra. The advanced portrait features adjust skin tones and preserve natural textures, giving every shot a polished, professional look.
      • SWITCHING IS QUICK & EASY: With Smart Switch, you can move your pics, videos, music, apps, contacts and convos to their new home, safely and securely, in just a few simple steps.

      Galaxy S25 Ultra handles the small details so you can focus on staying in the moment. Get several tasks fulfilled with one simple ask, and get insightful tips throughout your day to stay one step ahead. Simplify life with AI¹⁰ that evolves with you to work better for you.

      ¹Compatible with select apps. Requires Google Gemini account. Results may vary based on input; check responses for accuracy. ²Displays daily select information from select apps (some apps may require internet connection). ³Compatible with common video formats accessible in Gallery; helps minimize six sounds (Voice/speech, Music, Noise, Crowd, Nature, Wind). Utilizes AI; results vary. ⁴As compared to Galaxy S24 Ultra. ⁵Requires screen resolution setting to QHD+. ⁶Galaxy AI features track data and require a compatible Galaxy wearable device (sold separately), Samsung Health app and Samsung account. ⁹Galaxy AI features track data and require a compatible Galaxy wearable device (sold separately), Samsung Health app and Samsung account. ¹⁰Galaxy AI features by Samsung are free through 2025 and require Samsung account login.

      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      Flagship Brains, FE Price — Incredible 2025 Value
      ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Flagship Brains, FE Price — Incredible 2025 Value Samsung S25 FE Review: The Smartest “Affordable” Doesn’t Feel Affordable I upgraded to the Samsung Galaxy S25 FE 256GB (Unlocked, 2025) and it instantly proved that FE no longer means “the budget cousin.” It delivers a flagship-style experience powered by actual intelligence. The display is bright, sharp, and smooth, making everything from doom-scrolling to spreadsheets look unfairly good. The 256GB storage is perfect for heavy app users and photo hoarders like me — plenty of space, zero cloud-panicked storage math. Performance-wise, this phone is a multitasking ninja. I run work apps, streaming, navigation, and background downloads, and it handles everything without drama, lag, or turning into a pocket heater. The AI features genuinely help too — smart photo enhancement, writing suggestions, and adaptive system tweaks that make everyday use feel faster and more intuitive. The unlocked flexibility is a huge bonus — carrier switching, travel SIMs, or no SIM at all, it just works. Battery life? Solid. It gets me through the day with space to spare, even with heavier 5G and app usage. ✅ Pros: ✔ Fast and smooth performance for daily tasks ✔ AI features are actually useful (not salesperson poetry) ✔ 256GB storage = generous and practical ✔ Slim, modern FE design looks premium ✔ Handles 5G and accessories reliably ✔ Unlocked freedom is clutch ✔ No bloat-feeling slowdown so far ⚠ Cons / Tips: • Not the absolute top-tier S line — but honestly, unless you stare at spec sheets for sport, you’ll never feel like you compromised. • Pair with a good USB-C GaN Charger if you want maximum fast-charging efficiency. • Because it’s FE-light and sleek, consider a grippy magnetic case if you like snap-on accessories. Bottom line: If you want a phone that delivers flagship thinking, amazing everyday performance, and smart storage value — without flagship pricing guilt, this is your 2025 sweet spot. The S25 FE earns 5 stars not because it’s “affordable”… but because it never makes you think about the word affordable at all. 😎📱⚡💡👏

        5.0 out of 5 stars Wow! Exceeded my expectations in every way.. Love it!
        Reviewed in the United States on December 17, 2025
        Color: Titanium BlackSize: 256GBStyle: S25 UltraPattern Name: Phone OnlyVerified Purchase
        Been buying cell phones since the beginning all the way back to when they were called car phones, lol (shows my age)

        Once they went to texting and smart phones I have always bought budget model phones Samsung, Moto, etc.. I never really used them for more than texting and phone calls. Then came 2FA and apps for everything. I have always liked Samsung phones, I was ready for a new device and this time I decided to look at the top tier devices during the sales.

        NEVER APPLE or ONE PLUS so would be Pixel 10 Pro or S25 Ultra. Bought both...

        Usually I spent $150 -$200 and they get the job done so I was sceptical on spending $1K on a phone. The Pixel was ok, though not worth it over what I already had. Then the Samsung S25 Ultra arrived (with a free bundled set or Pro 3 Ear Buds) and all I can say is Wow!

        This thing is built like a tank, super quality construction. Love the material, screen OLED is amazing, camera is outstanding and the audio synced with the Pro 3 Buds is unreal. Put Spotify on and I hear thing in songs I have never heard before, the clarity and frequency response is like nothing I have ever heard before.

        I love Samsung because you can customize almost everything about this phone, they don't load it with bloat, and they make it easy to disable features if you don't want them, unlike some other brands. I run mine pretty lean without a lot of background stuff going and the battery charge lasts longer than any other phone I have had. I did not expect that at all. And it charges fast.

        Has every function I could possibly need and more is I want it. The feel is pure quality, has the durable OLED glass for protection. This thing has exceeded my expectations in every way and if you can get one, it is well worth it. IMO

        5.0 out of 5 stars Perfect phone for not getting locked in for 24 mos. with some carrier
        Reviewed in the United States on September 20, 2025
        Color: WhiteSize: 256GBStyle: S25 FEPattern Name: Phone OnlyVerified Purchase
        With there being really no options now for a few phone or low price upgrade on any carrier this was a great deal. Not only cheaper than if I got thru my carrier locally, but it's unlocked so I can switch off I want to. IT ALSO CAME WITH A PROMO OF DBL STORAGE FOR FREE AND A 100 AMAZON GC!!!

        Why I like this phone. LITERALLY took 5 minds to set up and transfer all my contacts and apps and set up on with my carrier.
        It is much lighter than my old Samsung 36.

        IT IS spec wise so close to the samsung s25.

        It is so fast with built in AI features which are fun and helpful.

        Overall if you are an android user this phone feels and acts like the phones that are 1200$ on up.

        I also like the changes. It has great sound, great"cleaner" on the phone, gorilla glass screen, and the fingerprint unlock feature is no longer the power button but on the screen.

        I learned long ago, even if you are super excited to start using the phone, be sure you charge it to 100% on the first charge. Then go to settings, battery , and set it to never over charge. OLD PHONE defaulted to cap at 85%, this one let's you set the top up to 95%. I used to have an electric vehicle and the batteries need to learn what 100 is but never overcharge. This will extend the life of the phone and prevent major headaches in the future. I keep mine on the charger overnight and playing my favorite sleep podcast- it stops at 95% and does not get hot.

        I am always playing audible books or podcasts and using Google maps. The battery stays charged and by the end of the day it's around 70%.

        I am thankful samsung put out a good "lower priced model" than the s25 ultra. I also ran into using 99% of my storage on my old phone(128gb) I have every kind of app on here and it's only using 28% of my total storage so I highly recommend getting the 512 GB of you need lots of room.

        I am one of those people that keeps a phone forever and I think this one will last me a very long time.

        Reviewed in the United States on September 28, 2025

        I recently purchased the Samsung Galaxy S25 SE, and so far, I’m really impressed. The phone is smooth, fast, and the specs are excellent.         The 256GB of storage is more than enough for me to keep all my pictures, documents, and apps without worrying about space. Speaking of pictures — the camera quality is fantastic. I love the clarity and detail in my photos, and I can’t wait to explore more of its camera features.

        Right now, I mostly use it for emails, pictures, and everyday tasks, and it hasn’t let me down. I haven’t even tapped into everything it can do yet, but the performance and safety features already make it worth it.

        Overall, this phone feels reliable, powerful, and future-proof. I’ll update my review after I’ve had a chance to test out more of the features, but for now, I can honestly say the Galaxy S25 SE is working great and I’m very happy with my purchase.

        The 256GB of storage is more than enough for me to keep all my pictures, documents, and apps without worrying about space. Speaking of pictures — the camera quality is fantastic. I love the clarity and detail in my photos, and I can’t wait to explore more of its camera features.

        Another reason I’m so satisfied is the price. I paid around $625 for the phone, and it even came with a $100 Amazon gift card, which made it an even better deal. For the performance and storage you get, I think the value is excellent.

        Right now, I mostly use it for emails, pictures, and everyday tasks, and it hasn’t let me down. I haven’t even tapped into everything it can do yet, but the performance and safety features already make it worth it.

        Overall, this phone feels reliable, powerful, and future-proof. I’ll update my review after I’ve had a chance to test out more of the features, but for now, I can honestly say the Galaxy S25 SE is working great and I’m very happy with my purchase.
